ticket.title: Something is not working
ticket.body: It is not working today. Can you fix it?

review.note: Demonstration review by build agent against example documentation. Clarification handoff: ask which product action failed, the exact error and approximate time. No outage or repair has been established.

resolution.summary: Customer reports that a feature or action is not working today and requests a fix.
resolution.follow_up_question: Which specific product action or feature is not working? Please provide the exact error message and the approximate time it occurred.

reasons: The proposed next action requires clarification or a human handoff

citations.quote: An unspecified "it does not work" report is insufficient evidence of a major incident. Ask which product action failed, the exact error and the approximate time; ask whether other users are affected if needed.
